subject: Marketplace channel migration: renewal uplift & billing transition timeline
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novacorp.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal questions — moving to Marketplace billing

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. We're approaching Novacorp's July 1 renewal and Procurement asked whether we can move to AWS Marketplace billing for this contract. The reasons: centralized billing, faster internal approvals, and co-sell eligibility.

Two asks from our side to evaluate feasibility quickly:
- Can Redwood provide an amendment that preserves our committed usage but changes billing to AWS Marketplace with a one-month overlap window?
- Any material impact to invoicing cadence or seat-based entitlements we should expect?

Procurement is on a tight cadence. If you can share a draft amendment and an ops checklist by EOD Thursday (6/17), we can start internal approvals.

Elena
Head of Cloud Procurement
Novacorp

Attachment: novacorp-requirements-summary.pdf (stub)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novacorp.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal questions — moving to Marketplace billing

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely support a Marketplace billing cutover for your renewal with minimal disruption. High level:

- Amendment scope: preserve committed SKUs/units and map them to the equivalent AWS Marketplace SKUs; we'll propose a one-month overlap where both direct and marketplace entitlements coexist to avoid service gaps.
- Invoicing: Billing will flow via AWS Marketplace post-cutover; Novacorp will receive marketplace invoices instead of monthly Redwood invoices. No change to usage-based metering semantics.
- Entitlements: We'll work with product to ensure seat counts map cleanly; in rare cases we need an entitlement ID rewrite—we'll call that out in the checklist.

I've attached a rough amendment draft and a migration checklist for your team to review. Laura (Ops) and Karthik (Marketplace GTM) are looped in to help with legal and marketplace listing details.

Proposed next steps:
1) Review attached amendment draft (redwood-amendment-draft_v1.pdf) — internal legal + Novacorp procurement feedback by Thu 6/17 EOD
2) We prepare final doc and run DocuSign for signature (target 6/22)
3) Technical cutover window: 6/28–6/30 (one-month overlap starting 7/1)

Does that timeline work for you?

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415 555 0139

Subject: Re: Renewal questions — moving to Marketplace billing

Aditya/Laura —

Thanks. Quick clarification from our billing operations: when the marketplace invoice is issued, will the tax handling and remit-to details be fully handled via AWS (i.e., Novacorp will pay AWS and AWS sends Redwood settlement)? We need that spelled out in the amendment. Also attach any AWS seller-of-record notes.

If you can add that block to the amendment and include an explicit table mapping current Redwood SKUs to Marketplace SKUs, Procurement can approve the change in principle. We'll aim to return comments by Thursday EOD.

—Procurement Ops
Novacorp
